name: Internal Mammary Artery
description: Paired arteries descending along the posterior surface of the anterior chest wall, ~1 cm lateral to the sternal border. Important conduit for CABG (LIMA to LAD). Bifurcates at the 6th intercostal space into musculophrenic and superior epigastric arteries. On CT: assess patency of grafts and for use as surgical conduit.
